title: McCastle's To the Skys!
description: Create Aeronautics holds a whole new way to apply amazing physics to your contraptions and world. To the Sky! is a mod pack that is centered around create aeronautics with a few additional mods to add to the experience for us nerds who love to tinker.
body:
Create Aeronautics is here! It holds a whole new way to apply amazing physics to your contraptions and world. 

McCastle's To the Sky! is a mod pack that is centered around Create Aeronautics with a few additional mods to add to the experience for us nerds who love to tinker!

So get tinkering and exploring minecraft like never before!

Main mods it adds are:
 
Chipped  
Comforts  
Create 
Create Aeronautics 
Create Bits 'n' Bobs 
Create Crafts & Additions 
Create Deco 
Create Propulsion: Simulated 
Create: Connected 
Create: Copycats+ 
Create: The Factory Must Grow  
Distant Horizons 
Dungeons and Taverns 
Farmer's Delight 
Iris 
Jade 
Just Enough Items 
Lithosphere 
Quark 
Ribbits 
Sable 
Sodium 
Sophisticated Backpacks 
Towns and Towers 
William Wythers' Overhauled Overworld 

And many more - See mod list for full list.
